nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Three blocks around a courtyard. Someone's washing, going nowhere in the still air.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: A slide, a bench, and a patch of concrete where the grass gave up.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You reached the flats behind the school: three blocks around a courtyard.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Between the blocks, the road comes out of a gap you did not walk through.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Stairs up between two blocks. Eleven steps, a landing, then more steps.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You go up. The landing is the same landing, and the stairs below are the ones you just came up.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You climbed the stair between the blocks and arrived back where you started.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You go back down. It takes the same number of steps.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You stay on the ground. The stairs are still there, going up.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is something at the edge of the planter. Green. Not the green of the hedge.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: You saw a green animal on the concrete beside the planter. You cannot say what it is.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It is wet, and it moves slowly, the way something moves when it is counting.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It does not run. It turns its head just enough to keep you in view.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Close up: a flat bill, wet fur, a tail like a paddle held clear of the ground.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: The green animal has a flat bill and a flat tail. Nothing else about it is clear.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You stay where you are. It carries on doing whatever it was doing.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It does not look at you the way an animal usually looks at a person.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You have seen a drawing of this. In the biology book. You cannot find the page.

effects.speaker: protagonist
effects.text: Something about the animal is like a drawing in the biology textbook. You cannot find the page.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You cannot tell what it is. You also cannot say whether it belongs here.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Still there. It has moved about a metre along the planter, towards the alley.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You still do not know what it is.
